<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="dark">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="description" content="Nebula Mission Control — a deep-space robotics fleet operations console for the Asteria-7 mission.">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark light">
<title>Nebula Mission Control — Asteria-7</title>
<style>
/* ============================================================
   NEBULA MISSION CONTROL — design tokens
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --font-sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  --font-display: "Bahnschrift", "DIN Alternate", "Oswald", "Arial Narrow", var(--font-sans);

  --sp-1:4px; --sp-2:8px; --sp-3:12px; --sp-4:16px; --sp-5:24px; --sp-6:32px; --sp-7:48px;
  --r-sm:6px; --r-md:10px; --r-lg:14px; --r-full:999px;
  --dur-1:120ms; --dur-2:200ms; --dur-3:320ms;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
  --topbar-h:60px;
  --sidebar-w:248px;
  --sidebar-w-collapsed:76px;
  --maxw:1440px;
}

/* ---- dark (default) ---- */
:root, [data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg-0:#070b14; --bg-1:#0b1120; --bg-2:#101a2e; --bg-3:#16233c;
  --surface:rgba(16,26,46,.72); --surface-solid:#0f1828;
  --border:rgba(120,150,190,.14); --border-strong:rgba(120,150,190,.28);
  --text-1:#e9f0fb; --text-2:#9fb0c9; --text-3:#63748f;
  --accent:#37d3e6; --accent-2:#7fe3f0; --accent-ink:#04121a;
  --accent-soft:rgba(55,211,230,.12); --accent-line:rgba(55,211,230,.35);
  --warn:#f5a524; --warn-soft:rgba(245,165,36,.14);
  --crit:#ff5d6c; --crit-soft:rgba(255,93,108,.14);
  --ok:#3ddc97; --ok-soft:rgba(61,220,151,.14);
  --off:#7c8aa3; --off-soft:rgba(124,138,163,.14);
  --grid:rgba(120,150,190,.05);
  --shadow-1:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  --shadow-2:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  --scrim:rgba(3,6,12,.6);
  --star:rgba(200,220,255,.5);
  --focus:0 0 0 2px var(--bg-0), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent);
}
/* ---- light ---- */
[data-theme="light"]{
  --bg-0:#eef2f8; --bg-1:#f5f8fc; --bg-2:#ffffff; --bg-3:#eef3fa;
  --surface:rgba(255,255,255,.82); --surface-solid:#ffffff;
  --border:rgba(30,50,80,.12); --border-strong:rgba(30,50,80,.24);
  --text-1:#0d1a2b; --text-2:#43566f; --text-3:#7a8aa0;
  --accent:#0b93a8; --accent-2:#0a7d90; --accent-ink:#ffffff;
  --accent-soft:rgba(11,147,168,.12); --accent-line:rgba(11,147,168,.4);
  --warn:#b9720a; --warn-soft:rgba(185,114,10,.14);
  --crit:#d63a49; --crit-soft:rgba(214,58,73,.12);
  --ok:#128a5c; --ok-soft:rgba(18,138,92,.14);
  --off:#6b7a90; --off-soft:rgba(107,122,144,.14);
  --grid:rgba(30,50,80,.05);
  --shadow-1:0 1px 2px rgba(20,40,70,.08), 0 8px 24px rgba(20,40,70,.10);
  --shadow-2:0 12px 40px rgba(20,40,70,.16);
  --scrim:rgba(20,30,50,.35);
  --star:rgba(30,50,80,.25);
  --focus:0 0 0 2px var(--bg-0), 0 0 0 4px var(--accent);
}

/* ============================================================
   base
   ============================================================ */
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%}
body{
  margin:0; font-family:var(--font-sans); color:var(--text-1);
  background:var(--bg-0); font-size:14px; line-height:1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; overflow-x:hidden;
}
body::before{ /* faint grid texture */
  content:""; position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0; pointer-events:none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size:44px 44px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, #000 40%, transparent 100%);
}
#starfield{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:.55}
[data-theme="light"] #starfield{opacity:.35}
.mono{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:.01em}
.num{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
h1,h2,h3,h4{margin:0; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em}
button{font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer}
a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:none; box-shadow:var(--focus); border-radius:var(--r-sm)}
.sr-only{position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0 0 0 0); white-space:nowrap; border:0}
.ic{width:18px; height:18px; flex:none; display:block}
.ic-sm{width:15px; height:15px}
.ic-lg{width:22px; height:22px}

/* ============================================================
   app shell
   ============================================================ */
.app{position:relative; z-index:1; display:grid; grid-template-rows:auto 1fr; min-height:100vh}
.main{display:grid; grid-template-columns:var(--sidebar-w) 1fr; transition:grid-template-columns var(--dur-3) var(--ease)}
.app.collapsed .main{grid-template-columns:var(--sidebar-w-collapsed) 1fr}

/* ---- topbar ---- */
.topbar{
  position:sticky; top:0; z-index:40; height:var(--topbar-h);
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:var(--sp-3);
  padding:0 var(--sp-4);
  background:var(--surface); backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-width:0}
.brand-mark{width:34px; height:34px; flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center;
  border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:var(--r-md);
  background:linear-gradient(160deg, var(--accent-soft), transparent); color:var(--accent)}
.brand-name{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:15px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap}
.brand-sub{font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--text-3); white-space:nowrap}
.mission-chip{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:5px 10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-full); background:var(--bg-2); font-size:12px; white-space:nowrap}
.mission-chip .dot{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent)}
.mission-chip b{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-weight:600}
.mission-chip .elapsed{color:var(--text-2); font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px}
.topbar-spacer{flex:1}
.topbar-right{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:var(--sp-2)}

.link-status{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--text-2); padding:5px 10px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-full); background:var(--bg-2)}
.link-status .dot{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ok); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--ok)}
.link-status.warn .dot{background:var(--warn); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--warn)}
.utc{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--text-2); letter-spacing:.04em; white-space:nowrap}

.icon-btn{position:relative; width:38px; height:38px; display:grid; place-items:center;
  border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-2);
  transition:color var(--dur-1), border-color var(--dur-1), background var(--dur-1), transform var(--dur-1)}
.icon-btn:hover{color:var(--text-1); border-color:var(--border-strong); background:var(--bg-3)}
.icon-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.badge{position:absolute; top:-6px; right:-6px; min-width:18px; height:18px; padding:0 5px;
  display:grid; place-items:center; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; font-weight:700;
  background:var(--crit); color:#fff; border-radius:var(--r-full); border:2px solid var(--bg-0)}
.badge:empty{display:none}

.search-btn{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:38px; padding:0 12px;
  border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-3);
  min-width:210px; transition:border-color var(--dur-1), color var(--dur-1)}
.search-btn:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong); color:var(--text-2)}
.search-btn .kbd{margin-left:auto}
.kbd{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; padding:2px 6px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-bottom-width:2px; border-radius:5px; color:var(--text-2); background:var(--bg-3); letter-spacing:.02em}

.user-btn{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; height:38px; padding:0 8px 0 10px;
  border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-1)}
.user-btn:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong)}
.avatar{width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center;
  font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-ink);
  background:linear-gradient(150deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2))}
.user-btn .uname{font-size:12px; font-weight:600}
.user-btn .caret{color:var(--text-3)}

/* ---- sidebar ---- */
.sidebar{position:sticky; top:var(--topbar-h); height:calc(100vh - var(--topbar-h));
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:var(--sp-2); padding:var(--sp-3);
  background:var(--surface); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); border-right:1px solid var(--border);
  overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden}
.nav{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px}
.nav-item{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:var(--r-md);
  color:var(--text-2); font-size:13px; font-weight:500; border:1px solid transparent; position:relative;
  transition:background var(--dur-1), color var(--dur-1), border-color var(--dur-1)}
.nav-item:hover{background:var(--bg-3); color:var(--text-1)}
.nav-item[aria-current="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--text-1); border-color:var(--accent-line)}
.nav-item[aria-current="true"]::before{content:""; position:absolute; left:-3px; top:8px; bottom:8px; width:3px;
  border-radius:3px; background:var(--accent)}
.nav-item .ic{color:var(--text-3)}
.nav-item[aria-current="true"] .ic{color:var(--accent)}
.nav-item .label{white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis}
.nav-item .count{margin-left:auto; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; font-weight:700;
  padding:1px 7px; border-radius:var(--r-full); background:var(--bg-3); color:var(--text-2); border:1px solid var(--border)}
.nav-item .count.crit{background:var(--crit-soft); color:var(--crit); border-color:transparent}
.sidebar-foot{margin-top:auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; padding-top:var(--sp-3); border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.collapse-btn{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:9px 11px; border-radius:var(--r-md);
  border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-2); font-size:12px}
.collapse-btn:hover{color:var(--text-1); border-color:var(--border-strong)}
.collapse-btn .ic{transition:transform var(--dur-2) var(--ease)}
.app.collapsed .collapse-btn .ic{transform:rotate(180deg)}
/* collapsed state */
.app.collapsed .nav-item .label, .app.collapsed .nav-item .count,
.app.collapsed .collapse-btn .label, .app.collapsed .brand-sub{display:none}
.app.collapsed .nav-item{justify-content:center; padding:10px}
.app.collapsed .collapse-btn{justify-content:center; padding:10px}
.app.collapsed .nav-item .ic{margin:0}

/* ---- content ---- */
.content{min-width:0; padding:var(--sp-5); background:
  radial-gradient(900px 400px at 80% -10%, var(--accent-soft), transparent 60%), var(--bg-0)}
.content-inner{max-width:var(--maxw); margin:0 auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:var(--sp-5)}

/* ---- page header ---- */
.page-head{display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between; gap:var(--sp-4); flex-wrap:wrap}
.page-head h1{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:30px; letter-spacing:.02em; line-height:1}
.page-head .sub{color:var(--text-2); font-size:13px; margin-top:6px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.page-head .sub .sync{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--text-3)}
.page-head .sub .sync b{color:var(--accent); font-weight:600}
.head-actions{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:var(--sp-2); flex-wrap:wrap}

.seg{display:inline-flex; padding:3px; gap:2px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--bg-2)}
.seg button{border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--text-2); font-size:12px; font-weight:600;
  padding:6px 12px; border-radius:7px; font-family:var(--font-mono); letter-spacing:.02em; transition:background var(--dur-1), color var(--dur-1)}
.seg button:hover{color:var(--text-1)}
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent)}

.btn{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:38px; padding:0 14px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600;
  border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-1);
  transition:background var(--dur-1), border-color var(--dur-1), transform var(--dur-1), box-shadow var(--dur-1)}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent-line); background:var(--bg-3)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn .ic{color:var(--text-2)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); border-color:transparent; box-shadow:0 6px 18px var(--accent-soft)}
.btn.primary:hover{background:var(--accent-2)}
.btn.primary .ic{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent}
.btn.sm{height:32px; padding:0 11px; font-size:12px}
.btn.danger{color:var(--crit); border-color:var(--crit-soft)}
.btn.danger:hover{background:var(--crit-soft); border-color:var(--crit)}

/* ============================================================
   panels
   ============================================================ */
.panel{background:var(--surface); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg); box-shadow:var(--shadow-1); overflow:hidden}
.panel-head{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:var(--sp-3); padding:14px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.panel-head h2{font-size:14px; letter-spacing:.02em}
.panel-head .ph-sub{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3); font-family:var(--font-mono); letter-spacing:.04em}
.panel-head .ph-right{margin-left:auto; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px}
.panel-body{padding:16px}
.panel-body.flush{padding:0}

/* ============================================================
   KPI
   ============================================================ */
.kpi-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:var(--sp-4)}
.kpi{position:relative; background:var(--surface); backdrop-filter:blur(10px); border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg); padding:16px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-1); overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform var(--dur-2) var(--ease), border-color var(--dur-2), box-shadow var(--dur-2)}
.kpi::before{content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:3px; background:var(--accent); opacity:.7}
.kpi[data-tone="warn"]::before{background:var(--warn)}
.kpi[data-tone="crit"]::before{background:var(--crit)}
.kpi[data-tone="ok"]::before{background:var(--ok)}
.kpi:hover{transform:translateY(-3px); border-color:var(--border-strong); box-shadow:var(--shadow-2)}
.kpi-top{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px}
.kpi-label{font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--text-3); font-weight:600}
.kpi-status{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em;
  text-transform:uppercase; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:var(--r-full)}
.kpi-status .dot{width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%}
.kpi-status.ok{color:var(--ok); background:var(--ok-soft)} .kpi-status.ok .dot{background:var(--ok)}
.kpi-status.warn{color:var(--warn); background:var(--warn-soft)} .kpi-status.warn .dot{background:var(--warn)}
.kpi-status.crit{color:var(--crit); background:var(--crit-soft)} .kpi-status.crit .dot{background:var(--crit)}
.kpi-value{display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:6px; margin-top:12px}
.kpi-value .v{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:34px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em; line-height:1}
.kpi-value .u{font-size:13px; color:var(--text-2); font-family:var(--font-mono)}
.kpi-foot{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; margin-top:12px}
.kpi-delta{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12px; font-weight:600}
.kpi-delta .ic{width:13px; height:13px}
.kpi-delta.up{color:var(--ok)} .kpi-delta.down{color:var(--crit)} .kpi-delta.flat{color:var(--text-3)}
.kpi-delta .lbl{color:var(--text-3); font-weight:400; font-size:11px}
.kpi-spark{width:96px; height:34px; flex:none}

/* ============================================================
   telemetry chart
   ============================================================ */
.chart-wrap{position:relative; height:300px}
.chart-wrap svg{display:block; width:100%; height:100%}
.chart-legend{display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.legend-item{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:5px 10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-full); background:var(--bg-2); font-size:12px; color:var(--text-2); transition:opacity var(--dur-1), border-color var(--dur-1)}
.legend-item .sw{width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:3px}
.legend-item[aria-pressed="false"]{opacity:.4}
.legend-item[aria-pressed="false"] .sw{background:var(--text-3)!important}
.legend-item:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong); color:var(--text-1)}
.chart-tip{position:absolute; pointer-events:none; z-index:5; min-width:150px; padding:9px 11px;
  background:var(--surface-solid); border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:var(--r-md);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-2); font-size:12px; opacity:0; transform:translateY(4px); transition:opacity var(--dur-1), transform var(--dur-1)}
.chart-tip.show{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)}
.chart-tip .tt-time{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3); margin-bottom:6px; letter-spacing:.04em}
.chart-tip .tt-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; margin-top:3px}
.chart-tip .tt-row .sw{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:2px}
.chart-tip .tt-row .nm{color:var(--text-2); flex:1}
.chart-tip .tt-row .vl{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-weight:600}

/* ============================================================
   orbit
   ============================================================ */
.orbit-wrap{position:relative; height:300px; background:
  radial-gradient(120% 120% at 50% 50%, transparent 55%, var(--bg-1) 100%)}
.orbit-wrap svg{display:block; width:100%; height:100%}
.orbit-controls{display:flex; gap:6px}
.orbit-controls .icon-btn{width:34px; height:34px}
.orbit-controls .icon-btn.wide{width:auto; padding:0 12px; font-size:12px; font-family:var(--font-mono); gap:6px}
.orbit-zoom{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3); min-width:44px; text-align:center}

/* ============================================================
   fleet table
   ============================================================ */
.table-tools{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.search-input{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:34px; padding:0 10px; min-width:200px;
  border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-2)}
.search-input:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent-line); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}
.search-input .ic{color:var(--text-3)}
.search-input input{border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--text-1); font-size:13px; width:100%; outline:none}
.search-input input::placeholder{color:var(--text-3)}
.chips{display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:30px; padding:0 11px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600;
  border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-full); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-2);
  transition:background var(--dur-1), color var(--dur-1), border-color var(--dur-1)}
.chip .dot{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong); color:var(--text-1)}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--text-1); border-color:var(--accent-line)}
.chip .dot.nominal{background:var(--ok)} .chip .dot.degraded{background:var(--warn)}
.chip .dot.critical{background:var(--crit)} .chip .dot.offline{background:var(--off)}
.chip .dot.all{background:var(--accent)}

.table-scroll{overflow-x:auto}
table.fleet{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; min-width:820px}
table.fleet thead th{position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--surface-solid); z-index:2; text-align:left;
  font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--text-3); font-weight:700;
  padding:11px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); white-space:nowrap; user-select:none}
table.fleet thead th.sortable{cursor:pointer}
table.fleet thead th.sortable:hover{color:var(--text-1)}
table.fleet thead th .th-in{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px}
table.fleet thead th .sort-ic{opacity:0; transition:opacity var(--dur-1)}
table.fleet thead th[aria-sort] .sort-ic{opacity:1; color:var(--accent)}
table.fleet tbody td{padding:12px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); font-size:13px; white-space:nowrap}
table.fleet tbody tr{cursor:pointer; transition:background var(--dur-1)}
table.fleet tbody tr:hover{background:var(--bg-3)}
table.fleet tbody tr[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft)}
table.fleet tbody tr:focus-visible{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent)}
.cell-name{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px}
.cell-name .nm{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em}
.cell-name .model{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3)}
.status-pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em;
  padding:3px 9px; border-radius:var(--r-full); text-transform:capitalize}
.status-pill .dot{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%}
.status-pill.nominal{color:var(--ok); background:var(--ok-soft)} .status-pill.nominal .dot{background:var(--ok)}
.status-pill.degraded{color:var(--warn); background:var(--warn-soft)} .status-pill.degraded .dot{background:var(--warn)}
.status-pill.critical{color:var(--crit); background:var(--crit-soft)} .status-pill.critical .dot{background:var(--crit)}
.status-pill.offline{color:var(--off); background:var(--off-soft)} .status-pill.offline .dot{background:var(--off)}
.bar{width:64px; height:6px; border-radius:3px; background:var(--bg-3); overflow:hidden; display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle}
.bar > i{display:block; height:100%; border-radius:3px; background:var(--accent)}
.bar.warn > i{background:var(--warn)} .bar.crit > i{background:var(--crit)} .bar.off > i{background:var(--off)}
.cell-num{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cell-num .u{color:var(--text-3); font-size:11px}
.owner{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px}
.owner .av{width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; font-family:var(--font-mono);
  font-size:10px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-ink); background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-2))}
.table-foot{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding:12px 16px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.table-foot .info{font-size:12px; color:var(--text-3); font-family:var(--font-mono)}
.empty{padding:48px 20px; text-align:center; color:var(--text-3)}
.empty .ic{width:40px; height:40px; margin:0 auto 12px; opacity:.5}
.empty h3{color:var(--text-2); font-size:15px; margin-bottom:6px}
.empty p{font-size:13px; margin:0 0 16px}

/* ============================================================
   events
   ============================================================ */
.event-list{display:flex; flex-direction:column}
.event{display:flex; gap:12px; padding:13px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); position:relative; transition:background var(--dur-1)}
.event:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.event:hover{background:var(--bg-3)}
.event .rail{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex:none}
.event .sev-dot{width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; flex:none}
.event .sev-dot.critical{background:var(--crit); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--crit)}
.event .sev-dot.warning{background:var(--warn)} .event .sev-dot.info{background:var(--accent)}
.event .sev-dot.resolved{background:var(--ok)}
.event .body{flex:1; min-width:0}
.event .title{font-size:13px; font-weight:600; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.event .title .tag{font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:var(--r-full)}
.event .title .tag.critical{color:var(--crit); background:var(--crit-soft)}
.event .title .tag.warning{color:var(--warn); background:var(--warn-soft)}
.event .title .tag.info{color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft)}
.event .title .tag.resolved{color:var(--ok); background:var(--ok-soft)}
.event .desc{font-size:12px; color:var(--text-2); margin-top:4px}
.event .meta{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3); font-family:var(--font-mono); margin-top:6px; display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.event .read-btn{flex:none; align-self:flex-start; width:30px; height:30px; display:grid; place-items:center;
  border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-3)}
.event .read-btn:hover{color:var(--text-1); border-color:var(--border-strong)}
.event.read{opacity:.62}
.event.read .title .tag{opacity:.7}
.event .unread-mark{width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--accent)}
.event.read .unread-mark{display:none}

/* ============================================================
   kanban
   ============================================================ */
.kanban{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:var(--sp-3); align-items:start}
.kcol{background:var(--bg-2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-md); display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-height:120px}
.kcol-head{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:11px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.kcol-head .kdot{width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%}
.kcol-head .kdot.planning{background:var(--accent)} .kcol-head .kdot.transit{background:var(--warn)}
.kcol-head .kdot.orbit{background:var(--ok)} .kcol-head .kdot.complete{background:var(--off)}
.kcol-head .ktitle{font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase}
.kcol-head .kcount{margin-left:auto; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3)}
.kcol-body{padding:10px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; min-height:60px; transition:background var(--dur-1), box-shadow var(--dur-1)}
.kcol-body.drag-over{background:var(--accent-soft); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-line); border-radius:var(--r-sm)}
.kcard{background:var(--surface-solid); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-md); padding:11px 12px;
  cursor:grab; transition:transform var(--dur-1), box-shadow var(--dur-1), border-color var(--dur-1); position:relative}
.kcard:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong); box-shadow:var(--shadow-1)}
.kcard.dragging{opacity:.4; cursor:grabbing}
.kcard .kcode{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--accent); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em}
.kcard .kname{font-size:13px; font-weight:600; margin-top:3px}
.kcard .kmeta{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:9px; gap:8px}
.kcard .kprog{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--text-2)}
.kcard .kmove{width:28px; height:28px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--r-sm); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-3)}
.kcard .kmove:hover{color:var(--text-1); border-color:var(--border-strong)}
.kcard .kmove .ic{width:15px; height:15px}
.kcard .kbar{height:4px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--bg-3); margin-top:9px; overflow:hidden}
.kcard .kbar > i{display:block; height:100%; background:var(--accent)}

/* ============================================================
   drawer
   ============================================================ */
.scrim{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:60; background:var(--scrim); opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity var(--dur-2)}
.scrim.show{opacity:1; pointer-events:auto}
.drawer{position:fixed; top:0; right:0; bottom:0; z-index:70; width:min(440px,100%);
  background:var(--surface-solid); border-left:1px solid var(--border-strong); box-shadow:var(--shadow-2);
  transform:translateX(100%); transition:transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease); display:flex; flex-direction:column}
.drawer.show{transform:translateX(0)}
.drawer-head{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:18px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.drawer-head .dh-ic{width:44px; height:44px; flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent)}
.drawer-head .dh-name{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:18px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.02em}
.drawer-head .dh-model{font-size:12px; color:var(--text-2); margin-top:2px}
.drawer-head .dh-close{margin-left:auto}
.drawer-body{flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:18px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:18px}
.dsec-title{font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--text-3); font-weight:700; margin-bottom:10px}
.dmetrics{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px}
.dmetric{background:var(--bg-2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--r-md); padding:11px 12px}
.dmetric .dl{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3); letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase}
.dmetric .dv{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:19px; font-weight:600; margin-top:5px}
.dmetric .dv .u{font-size:12px; color:var(--text-2)}
.dtimeline{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0}
.dtl-item{display:flex; gap:12px; position:relative; padding-bottom:16px}
.dtl-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.dtl-item::before{content:""; position:absolute; left:5px; top:14px; bottom:-2px; width:2px; background:var(--border)}
.dtl-item:last-child::before{display:none}
.dtl-item .dtl-dot{width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; flex:none; margin-top:3px; border:2px solid var(--surface-solid)}
.dtl-item .dtl-dot.critical{background:var(--crit)} .dtl-item .dtl-dot.warning{background:var(--warn)}
.dtl-item .dtl-dot.info{background:var(--accent)} .dtl-item .dtl-dot.resolved{background:var(--ok)}
.dtl-item .dtl-t{font-size:13px; font-weight:600}
.dtl-item .dtl-d{font-size:12px; color:var(--text-2); margin-top:2px}
.dtl-item .dtl-time{font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3); margin-top:3px}
.drawer-foot{padding:14px 18px; border-top:1px solid var(--border); display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap}
.drawer-foot .btn{flex:1; justify-content:center; min-width:110px}

/* ============================================================
   popover / menu
   ============================================================ */
.popover{position:fixed; z-index:80; min-width:240px; background:var(--surface-solid); border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg); box-shadow:var(--shadow-2); opacity:0; transform:translateY(-6px) scale(.98); transform-origin:top right;
  transition:opacity var(--dur-1), transform var(--dur-1); pointer-events:none}
.popover.show{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1); pointer-events:auto}
.pop-head{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:13px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.pop-head h3{font-size:13px}
.pop-head .link{font-size:12px; color:var(--accent); background:none; border:0; font-weight:600}
.pop-head .link:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.pop-list{max-height:340px; overflow-y:auto; padding:6px}
.pop-item{display:flex; gap:10px; padding:10px; border-radius:var(--r-md); cursor:pointer; transition:background var(--dur-1)}
.pop-item:hover,.pop-item:focus-visible{background:var(--bg-3)}
.pop-item .pi-ic{width:30px; height:30px; flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-2)}
.pop-item .pi-t{font-size:13px; font-weight:600}
.pop-item .pi-d{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3); margin-top:2px}
.pop-item .pi-time{margin-left:auto; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; color:var(--text-3); align-self:center}
.menu{position:fixed; z-index:80; min-width:190px; background:var(--surface-solid); border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius:var(--r-md); box-shadow:var(--shadow-2); padding:6px; opacity:0; transform:translateY(-4px); transition:opacity var(--dur-1), transform var(--dur-1); pointer-events:none}
.menu.show{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); pointer-events:auto}
.menu-item{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; padding:9px 11px; border:0; background:transparent;
  color:var(--text-1); font-size:13px; border-radius:var(--r-sm); text-align:left}
.menu-item:hover,.menu-item:focus-visible{background:var(--bg-3)}
.menu-item .ic{color:var(--text-3)}
.menu-item.danger{color:var(--crit)} .menu-item.danger .ic{color:var(--crit)}
.menu-sep{height:1px; background:var(--border); margin:6px 4px}

/* ============================================================
   command palette
   ============================================================ */
.cmd-scrim{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:90; background:var(--scrim); display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:center;
  padding:12vh 16px 16px; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity var(--dur-1)}
.cmd-scrim.show{opacity:1; pointer-events:auto}
.cmd{width:min(640px,100%); background:var(--surface-solid); border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-2); overflow:hidden; transform:translateY(-10px) scale(.99); transition:transform var(--dur-2) var(--ease)}
.cmd-scrim.show .cmd{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
.cmd-input{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:16px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.cmd-input .ic{color:var(--text-3)}
.cmd-input input{flex:1; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--text-1); font-size:16px; outline:none}
.cmd-input input::placeholder{color:var(--text-3)}
.cmd-list{max-height:360px; overflow-y:auto; padding:8px}
.cmd-group{padding:8px 10px 4px; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--text-3); font-weight:700}
.cmd-item{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:11px 12px; border-radius:var(--r-md); cursor:pointer}
.cmd-item .ci-ic{width:32px; height:32px; flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--bg-2); color:var(--text-2)}
.cmd-item .ci-t{font-size:14px; font-weight:600}
.cmd-item .ci-d{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3); margin-top:1px}
.cmd-item .ci-hint{margin-left:auto; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; color:var(--text-3)}
.cmd-item.active{background:var(--accent-soft)}
.cmd-item.active .ci-ic{color:var(--accent)}
.cmd-foot{display:flex; gap:14px; padding:10px 16px; border-top:1px solid var(--border); font-size:11px; color:var(--text-3)}
.cmd-foot .kbd{margin:0 2px}

/* ============================================================
   modal
   ============================================================ */
.modal-scrim{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100; background:var(--scrim); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  padding:16px; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity var(--dur-1)}
.modal-scrim.show{opacity:1; pointer-events:auto}
.modal{width:min(440px,100%); background:var(--surface-solid); border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-2); transform:translateY(10px) scale(.98); transition:transform var(--dur-2) var(--ease)}
.modal-scrim.show .modal{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
.modal-head{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:18px 18px 0}
.modal-head .mh-ic{width:40px; height:40px; flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--warn-soft); color:var(--warn)}
.modal-head.danger .mh-ic{background:var(--crit-soft); color:var(--crit)}
.modal-head h3{font-size:16px}
.modal-body{padding:14px 18px; color:var(--text-2); font-size:13px; line-height:1.6}
.modal-body .mono{color:var(--text-1)}
.modal-foot{display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; padding:16px 18px; border-top:1px solid var(--border)}

/* ============================================================
   toasts
   ============================================================ */
.toast-region{position:fixed; z-index:120; right:16px; bottom:16px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; width:min(360px,calc(100vw - 32px))}
.toast{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:11px; padding:13px 14px; background:var(--surface-solid);
  border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-left-width:3px; border-radius:var(--r-md); box-shadow:var(--shadow-2);
  transform:translateX(120%); transition:transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease), opacity var(--dur-2)}
.toast.show{transform:translateX(0)}
.toast.hide{opacity:0; transform:translateX(120%)}
.toast .t-ic{width:26px; height:26px; flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:var(--r-sm)}
.toast.success{border-left-color:var(--ok)} .toast.success .t-ic{background:var(--ok-soft); color:var(--ok)}
.toast.info{border-left-color:var(--accent)} .toast.info .t-ic{background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent)}
.toast.warning{border-left-color:var(--warn)} .toast.warning .t-ic{background:var(--warn-soft); color:var(--warn)}
.toast.error{border-left-color:var(--crit)} .toast.error .t-ic{background:var(--crit-soft); color:var(--crit)}
.toast .t-body{flex:1; min-width:0}
.toast .t-title{font-size:13px; font-weight:700}
.toast .t-msg{font-size:12px; color:var(--text-2); margin-top:2px}
.toast .t-close{flex:none; width:24px; height:24px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--text-3); border-radius:var(--r-sm)}
.toast .t-close:hover{color:var(--text-1); background:var(--bg-3)}

/* ============================================================
   footer
   ============================================================ */
.app-foot{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:14px 4px 4px;
  color:var(--text-3); font-size:11px; font-family:var(--font-mono); flex-wrap:wrap}
.app-foot .fl{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px}
.app-foot .fl .dot{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ok); box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--ok)}
.app-foot .ver{color:var(--text-2)}

/* ============================================================
   skeleton
   ============================================================ */
.skeleton{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:200; background:var(--bg-0); padding:var(--sp-5);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:var(--sp-5); transition:opacity var(--dur-3) var(--ease)}
.skeleton.hide{opacity:0; pointer-events:none}
.sk{background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bg-2) 25%, var(--bg-3) 37%, var(--bg-2) 63%);
  background-size:400% 100%; animation:shimmer 1.4s infinite linear; border-radius:var(--r-md)}
@keyframes shimmer{0%{background-position:100% 0}100%{background-position:-100% 0}}
.sk-top{height:var(--topbar-h); border-radius:var(--r-md)}
.sk-kpis{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:var(--sp-4)}
.sk-kpis .sk{height:120px}
.sk-main{display:grid; grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr; gap:var(--sp-4)}
.sk-main .sk{height:300px}
.sk-table{height:280px}

/* ============================================================
   reveal
   ============================================================ */
.reveal{opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px); transition:opacity var(--dur-3) var(--ease), transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1; transform:none}

/* ============================================================
   responsive
   ============================================================ */
@media (max-width:1180px){
  .kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .sk-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .sk-main{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:1024px){
  .content{padding:var(--sp-4)}
  .page-head h1{font-size:26px}
  .search-btn{min-width:0}
  .search-btn .s-label{display:none}
}
@media (max-width:860px){
  .main{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sidebar{position:fixed; top:var(--topbar-h); left:0; bottom:0; width:280px; z-index:75;
    transform:translateX(-100%); transition:transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease); box-shadow:var(--shadow-2)}
  .app.nav-open .sidebar{transform:translateX(0)}
  .collapse-btn{display:none}
  .app.collapsed .nav-item .label, .app.collapsed .nav-item .count{display:block}
  .app.collapsed .nav-item{justify-content:flex-start; padding:9px 11px}
  .menu-toggle{display:grid}
  .kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .kanban{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .sk-kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .content{padding:var(--sp-3)}
  .page-head h1{font-size:22px}
  .kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sk-kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .kanban{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .utc{display:none}
  .link-status .ls-label{display:none}
  .search-btn{min-width:0; padding:0 10px}
  .search-btn .kbd{display:none}
  .user-btn .uname{display:none}
  .brand-sub{display:none}
  .mission-chip .elapsed{display:none}
  .chart-wrap{height:240px}
  .orbit-wrap{height:240px}
  .dmetrics{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .drawer{width:100%}
  .toast-region{left:16px; right:16px; width:auto}
}
.menu-toggle{display:none}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){

  function genSeries(range){
    const cfg = { "1H":{n:24,step:15}, "6H":{n:36,step:10}, "24H":{n:48,step:30}, "7D":{n:56,step:3} }[range];
    const n = cfg.n, stepMin = cfg.step;
    const end = BASE_NOW - state.step*STEP_MS;
    const start = end - (n-1)*stepMin*60000;
    const r = mulberry32(hashStr("telemetry:"+range+":"+state.step));
    const data = [];
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const t = i/(n-1);
      const w = (a,b,c)=> a*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2*b + c);
      const signal  = clamp(88 + 6*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2*1.3 + 0.4) + 3*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2*3.1 + 1.2) + (r()-0.5)*4, 40, 100);
      const thermal = clamp(46 + 14*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2*0.9 + 2.0) + 6*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2*2.4 + 0.7) + (r()-0.5)*5, 0, 100);
      const power   = clamp(74 - 10*t + 5*Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2*1.7 + 1.0) + (r()-0.5)*4, 0, 100);
      data.push({ t:start + i*stepMin*60000, signal:+signal.toFixed(1), thermal:+thermal.toFixed(1), power:+power.toFixed(1) });
    }
    return data;
  }

  function sparkline(values, color){
    const w=96,h=34,p=3; const min=Math.min(...values), max=Math.max(...values); const rng=(max-min)||1;
    const pts = values.map((v,i)=>{ const x=p+(i/(values.length-1))*(w-2*p); const y=h-p-((v-min)/rng)*(h-2*p); return [x,y]; });
    const line = pts.map((pt,i)=>(i?"L":"M")+pt[0].toFixed(1)+" "+pt[1].toFixed(1)).join(" ");
    const area = line+" L"+pts[pts.length-1][0].toFixed(1)+" "+(h-p)+" L"+pts[0][0].toFixed(1)+" "+(h-p)+" Z";
    const last = pts[pts.length-1];
    return '<svg class="kpi-spark" viewBox="0 0 '+w+' '+h+'" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">'+
      '<path d="'+area+'" fill="'+color+'" opacity="0.12"/>'+
      '<path d="'+line+'" fill="none" stroke="'+color+'" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>'+
      '<circle cx="'+last[0].toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+last[1].toFixed(1)+'" r="2.4" fill="'+color+'"/></svg>';

    const m = { l:44, r:16, t:14, b:26 };

    const t0 = data[0].t, t1 = data[data.length-1].t;
    const x = t => m.l + ((t-t0)/(t1-t0))*pw;
    const y = v => m.t + (1-(v-0)/100)*ph;

      const line = pts.map((p,i)=>(i?"L":"M")+p[0].toFixed(1)+" "+p[1].toFixed(1)).join(" ");
      const area = line+" L"+pts[pts.length-1][0].toFixed(1)+" "+(H-m.b)+" L"+pts[0][0].toFixed(1)+" "+(H-m.b)+" Z";
      const gid = "grad-"+s.key;

  function drawOrbit(){
    const svg = $("#orbitChart");
    const wrap = $("#orbitWrap");
    const W = wrap.clientWidth, H = wrap.clientHeight;
    if(W<10||H<10) return;
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox","0 0 "+W+" "+H);
    svg.innerHTML = "";
    const css = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
    const c = n => css.getPropertyValue(n).trim();
    const cx = W/2, cy = H/2;
    const base = Math.min(W,H)*0.42;
    const z = state.orbitZoom;
    const R = base*z;
    const rEarth = 14, rMoon = 5, rAst = 6;
    const earthR = R*0.30, moonR = R*0.52, astR = R*0.78;

    // starfield dots (deterministic)
    const rs = mulberry32(99);
    for(let i=0;i<40;i++){
      const sx = rs()*W, sy = rs()*H, sr = rs()*1.2+0.3;
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("circle",{cx:sx,cy:sy,r:sr,fill:c("--star"),opacity:(0.2+rs()*0.4).toFixed(2)}));
    }
    // orbits
    const orbit = (r, dash)=>{
      const e = svgEl("ellipse",{cx:cx,cy:cy,rx:r,ry:r*0.62,fill:"none",stroke:c("--border-strong"),"stroke-width":1});
      if(dash) e.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","4 5");
      svg.appendChild(e);
    };
    orbit(earthR); orbit(moonR, true); orbit(astR);

    // sun
    const sunGlow = svgEl("circle",{cx:cx,cy:cy,r:26,fill:"var(--warn)",opacity:"0.12"});
    svg.appendChild(sunGlow);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("circle",{cx:cx,cy:cy,r:11,fill:"var(--warn)"}));
    const sunT = svgEl("text",{x:cx,y:cy+34,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":10,fill:c("--text-3"),"font-family":"var(--font-mono)"});
    sunT.textContent="SUN"; svg.appendChild(sunT);

    // positions
    const angE = 0.6, angM = 2.4, angA = 4.1;
    const pos = (r,a)=>[cx+Math.cos(a)*r, cy+Math.sin(a)*r*0.62];
    const [ex,ey]=pos(earthR,angE), [mx,my]=pos(moonR,angM), [ax,ay]=pos(astR,angA);

  function statusRank(s){ return { nominal:0, degraded:1, critical:2, offline:3 }[s] ?? 0; }
  function filteredFleet(){
    const q = state.filters.q.trim().toLowerCase();
    let rows = FLEET.filter(f=>{
      if(state.filters.status!=="all" && f.status!==state.filters.status) return false;
      if(q){ const hay=(f.name+" "+f.id+" "+f.model+" "+f.owner).toLowerCase(); if(!hay.includes(q)) return false; }
      return true;
    });
    const { key, dir } = state.sort;
    rows.sort((a,b)=>{
      let av=a[key], bv=b[key];
      if(key==="status"){ av=statusRank(a.status); bv=statusRank(b.status); }
      if(typeof av==="string"){ return av.localeCompare(bv)*dir; }
      return (av-bv)*dir;
    });
    return rows;
  }

  function trapFocus(container, e){
    if(e.key!=="Tab") return;
    const f = $$('a[href],button:not([disabled]),input,select,textarea,[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])', container)
      .filter(el=>el.offsetParent!==null);
    if(!f.length) return;
    const first=f[0], last=f[f.length-1];
    if(e.shiftKey && document.activeElement===first){ e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if(!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement===last){ e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }

    const list = $("#cmdList");
    list.innerHTML = "";
    const filtered = cmdItems.filter(it=> !q || (it.label+" "+it.desc+" "+it.group).toLowerCase().includes(q));
    if(filtered.length===0){
      list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="padding:24px"><h3>No matches</h3><p>Try a different command.</p></div>';
      return;
    }
    let lastGroup = "";
    filtered.forEach((it,i)=>{
      if(it.group!==lastGroup){
        const g = document.createElement("div");
        g.className = "cmd-group"; g.textContent = it.group;
        list.appendChild(g); lastGroup = it.group;
      }
      const el = document.createElement("div");
      el.className = "cmd-item"+(i===cmdIndex?" active":"");
      el.setAttribute("role","option");
      el.setAttribute("aria-selected", i===cmdIndex?"true":"false");
      el.dataset.idx = i;
      el.innerHTML = '<span class="ci-ic"><svg class="ic"><use href="#'+it.icon+'"/></svg></span><div><div class="ci-t">'+it.label+'</div><div class="ci-d">'+it.desc+'</div></div><span class="ci-hint">↵</span>';
      el.addEventListener("click", ()=>runCmd(i));
      el.addEventListener("mousemove", ()=>{ if(cmdIndex!==i){ cmdIndex=i; highlightCmd(); } });
      list.appendChild(el);
    });
    cmdItems = filtered;
    if(cmdIndex>=filtered.length) cmdIndex=0;
    highlightCmd();
  }
  function highlightCmd(){
    $$(".cmd-item", $("#cmdList")).forEach((el,i)=>{
      el.classList.toggle("active", i===cmdIndex);
      el.setAttribute("aria-selected", i===cmdIndex?"true":"false");
    });
    const act = $("#cmdList").querySelector(".cmd-item.active");
    if(act) act.scrollIntoView({ block:"nearest" });
  }
  function runCmd(i){
    const it = cmdItems[i];
    if(!it) return;
    closeCmd();
    it.run();
  }

  /* ============================================================
     MODAL
     ============================================================ */
  let modalOnConfirm = null;
  function openModal({ title, body, confirmLabel="Confirm", tone="", onConfirm }){
    modalOnConfirm = onConfirm;
    $("#modalTitle").textContent = title;
    $("#modalBody").innerHTML = body;
    $("#modalConfirm").textContent = confirmLabel;
    $("#modalHead").className = "modal-head"+(tone?" "+tone:"");
    $("#modalScrim").classList.add("show");
    $("#modalScrim").setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
    lastFocused = document.activeElement;
    setTimeout(()=>$("#modalConfirm").focus(), 30);
  }
  function closeModal(){
    $("#modalScrim").classList.remove("show");
    $("#modalScrim").setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
    modalOnConfirm = null;
    if(lastFocused && lastFocused.focus) lastFocused.focus();
  }

  /* ============================================================
     TOASTS
     ============================================================ */
  function toast(type, title, msg){
    const region = $("#toastRegion");
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "toast "+type;
    el.setAttribute("role","status");
    const icon = type==="success"?"i-check":type==="warning"?"i-alert":type==="error"?"i-alert":"i-info";
    el.innerHTML =
      '<span class="t-ic"><svg class="ic"><use href="#'+icon+'"/></svg></span>'+
      '<div class="t-body"><div class="t-title">'+title+'</div><div class="t-msg">'+msg+'</div></div>'+
      '<button class="t-close" aria-label="Dismiss"><svg class="ic ic-sm"><use href="#i-x"/></svg></button>';
    region.appendChild(el);
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>el.classList.add("show"));
    const dismiss = ()=>{ el.classList.add("hide"); setTimeout(()=>el.remove(), 320); };
    el.querySelector(".t-close").addEventListener("click", dismiss);
    setTimeout(dismiss, 4200);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     SIMULATE
     ============================================================ */
  function simulate(){
    state.step = (state.step+1) % 1000;
    store.set(LS.step, state.step);
    state.lastSync = BASE_NOW + state.step*STEP_MS;
    // deterministic drift on a couple of probes
    FLEET.forEach(f=>{
      if(f.status==="offline") return;
      const r = mulberry32(hashStr(f.id+":"+state.step));
      f.signal = clamp(+(f.signal + (r()-0.5)*3).toFixed(1), 5, 100);
      f.temp   = clamp(+(f.temp + (r()-0.5)*2).toFixed(1), 5, 120);
      f.power  = clamp(Math.round(f.power + (r()-0.5)*2), 0, 100);
      f.last   = state.lastSync - Math.floor(r()*30)*60000;
    });
    // link status flicker
    const link = $("#linkStatus");
    link.classList.toggle("warn", state.step%5===0);
    link.querySelector(".ls-label").textContent = state.step%5===0 ? "Link · degraded" : "Link";

    renderKPIs();
    chart.data = genSeries(state.range);
    $("#telemetrySub").textContent = state.range+" · "+chart.data.length+" samples";
    drawChart();
    renderFleetBody();
    updateSync();
    toast("success","Telemetry updated", "Stream advanced to step "+state.step+" · "+fmtUTC(state.lastSync)+" UTC.");
  }
  function updateSync(){
    $("#lastSync").textContent = fmtUTC(state.lastSync)+" UTC";
    $("#footUpdated").textContent = "Updated "+fmtUTC(state.lastSync)+" UTC";
  }

  /* ============================================================
     RANGE
     ============================================================ */
  function setRange(r){
    state.range = r;
    store.set(LS.range, r);
    $$("#rangeSeg button").forEach(b=>b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.range===r)));
    chart.data = genSeries(r);
    $("#telemetrySub").textContent = r+" · "+chart.data.length+" samples";
    renderKPIs();
    drawChart();
  }

  /* ============================================================
     SIDEBAR / NAV DRAWER
     ============================================================ */
  function applyCollapsed(){
    $("#app").classList.toggle("collapsed", state.collapsed);
    $("#collapseBtn").setAttribute("aria-label", state.collapsed?"Expand sidebar":"Collapse sidebar");
    $("#collapseBtn .label").textContent = state.collapsed?"Expand":"Collapse";
    $("#collapseIcon").setAttribute("href", state.collapsed?"#i-chev-r":"#i-chev-l");
  }
  function openNavDrawer(){ $("#app").classList.add("nav-open"); $("#menuToggle").setAttribute("aria-expanded","true"); showScrim(); }
  function closeNavDrawer(){ $("#app").classList.remove("nav-open"); $("#menuToggle").setAttribute("aria-expanded","false"); if(!$("#drawer").classList.contains("show")) hideScrim(); }

  /* ============================================================
     STARFIELD
     ============================================================ */
  function initStarfield(){
    const cv = $("#starfield"), ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
    let stars = [], W=0, H=0, raf=null;
    function resize(){
      W = cv.width = innerWidth; H = cv.height = innerHeight;
      const n = Math.min(140, Math.floor(W*H/14000));
      const r = mulberry32(7);
      stars = Array.from({length:n}, ()=>({ x:r()*W, y:r()*H, r:r()*1.3+0.2, a:r()*0.5+0.15, s:r()*0.02+0.004, ph:r()*Math.PI*2 }));
    }
    function draw(t){
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
      const css = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
      const col = css.getPropertyValue("--star").trim();
      stars.forEach(s=>{
        const tw = reduceMotion ? 1 : (0.6 + 0.4*Math.sin(t*s.s + s.ph));
        ctx.globalAlpha = s.a*tw;
        ctx.fillStyle = col;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
      });
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      if(!reduceMotion) raf = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }
    resize();
    if(reduceMotion){ draw(0); } else { raf = requestAnimationFrame(draw); }
    addEventListener("resize", ()=>{ resize(); if(reduceMotion) draw(0); });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     REVEAL
     ============================================================ */
  function initReveal(){
    const els = $$(".reveal");
    if(reduceMotion || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)){ els.forEach(e=>e.classList.add("in")); return; }
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
      entries.forEach(en=>{ if(en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { threshold:0.08 });
    els.forEach(e=>io.observe(e));
  }

  /* ============================================================
     CLOCK
     ============================================================ */
  function tickClock(){
    const now = new Date();
    $("#utcClock").textContent = pad(now.getUTCHours())+":"+pad(now.getUTCMinutes())+":"+pad(now.getUTCSeconds())+" UTC";
    $("#missionElapsed").textContent = fmtElapsed(now.getTime()-MISSION_START);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     GLOBAL EVENTS
     ============================================================ */
  function onKey(e){
    const tag = (e.target.tagName||"").toLowerCase();
    const typing = tag==="input" || tag==="textarea" || e.target.isContentEditable;
    // Ctrl/Cmd + K
    if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase()==="k"){ e.preventDefault(); openCmd(); return; }
    // Escape
    if(e.key==="Escape"){
      if($("#cmdScrim").classList.contains("show")){ closeCmd(); return; }
      if($("#modalScrim").classList.contains("show")){ closeModal(); return; }
      if($("#drawer").classList.contains("show")){ closeDrawer(); return; }
      if($("#notifPop").classList.contains("show") || $("#userMenu").classList.contains("show")){ closeAllPopovers(); return; }
      if($("#app").classList.contains("nav-open")){ closeNavDrawer(); return; }
    }
    // command palette navigation
    if($("#cmdScrim").classList.contains("show")){
      if(typing && e.target===$("#cmdInput")){
        if(e.key==="ArrowDown"){ e.preventDefault(); cmdIndex=Math.min(cmdIndex+1, cmdItems.length-1); highlightCmd(); }
        else if(e.key==="ArrowUp"){ e.preventDefault(); cmdIndex=Math.max(cmdIndex-1,0); highlightCmd(); }
        else if(e.key==="Enter"){ e.preventDefault(); runCmd(cmdIndex); }
      }
      return;
    }
    // focus trap for drawer
    if($("#drawer").classList.contains("show")) trapFocus($("#drawer"), e);
    if($("#modalScrim").classList.contains("show")) trapFocus($("#modalScrim"), e);
  }
  function onDocClick(e){
    if(!e.target.closest("#notifPop") && !e.target.closest("#notifBtn")) { if($("#notifPop").classList.contains("show")) closeAllPopovers(); }
    if(!e.target.closest("#userMenu") && !e.target.closest("#userBtn")) { if($("#userMenu").classList.contains("show")) closeAllPopovers(); }
  }
  function onResize(){
    drawChart(); drawOrbit();
    if($("#notifPop").classList.contains("show")) positionPopover($("#notifPop"), $("#notifBtn"));
  }

  /* ============================================================
     INIT
     ============================================================ */
  function init(){
    // theme
    applyTheme();
    // kbd label
    $("#searchKbd").textContent = isMac ? "⌘K" : "Ctrl K";
    // nav
    renderNav();
    applyCollapsed();
    // range
    $$("#rangeSeg button").forEach(b=>b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.dataset.range===state.range)));
    // chart
    chart.data = genSeries(state.range);
    $("#telemetrySub").textContent = state.range+" · "+chart.data.length+" samples";
    renderLegend();
    // kpi
    renderKPIs();
    // orbit
    drawOrbit();
    // fleet
    $("#fleetSearch").value = state.filters.q;
    renderStatusChips();
    renderFleetHead();
    renderFleetBody();
    // events
    state.eventFilter = "all";
    renderEventChips();
    renderEvents();
    // kanban
    renderKanban();
    // notifications
    renderNotifications();
    // sync
    updateSync();
    // starfield
    initStarfield();
    // reveal
    initReveal();
    // clock
    tickClock();
    setInterval(tickClock, 1000);

    // ---- wire controls ----
    $("#themeBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleTheme);
    $("#searchBtn").addEventListener("click", openCmd);
    $("#notifBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleNotif);
    $("#userBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleUser);
    $("#menuToggle").addEventListener("click", ()=>{ $("#app").classList.contains("nav-open")?closeNavDrawer():openNavDrawer(); });
    $("#collapseBtn").addEventListener("click", ()=>{ state.collapsed=!state.collapsed; store.set(LS.sidebar,state.collapsed); applyCollapsed(); setTimeout(onResize,340); });
    $("#simBtn").addEventListener("click", simulate);
    $("#orbitIn").addEventListener("click", ()=>zoomOrbit(0.25));
    $("#orbitOut").addEventListener("click", ()=>zoomOrbit(-0.25));
    $("#orbitReset").addEventListener("click", ()=>{ state.orbitZoom=1; drawOrbit(); });
    $("#fleetSearch").addEventListener("input", e=>{ state.filters.q=e.target.value; store.set(LS.filters,state.filters); state.showMore=false; renderFleetBody(); });
    $("#fleetMore").addEventListener("click", ()=>{ state.showMore=!state.showMore; renderFleetBody(); });
    $("#drawerClose").addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
    $("#scrim").addEventListener("click", ()=>{ if($("#drawer").classList.contains("show")) closeDrawer(); else if($("#app").classList.contains("nav-open")) closeNavDrawer(); });
    $("#notifMarkAll").addEventListener("click", markAllRead);
    $$("#userMenu .menu-item").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
      const a = b.dataset.action;
      closeAllPopovers();
      if(a==="profile") toast("info","Profile","Signed in as E. Vance · Mission Director.");
      else if(a==="prefs") toast("info","Preferences","Preferences panel is a demo stub.");
      else if(a==="signout") openModal({ title:"Sign out", tone:"danger", body:"You are about to sign out of Nebula Mission Control. This is a simulated action and will not affect the live mission.", confirmLabel:"Sign out", onConfirm:()=>toast("success","Signed out","Session ended (simulated).") });
    }));
    // range seg
    $$("#rangeSeg button").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click", ()=>setRange(b.dataset.range)));
    // command palette input
    $("#cmdInput").addEventListener("input", ()=>{ cmdIndex=0; renderCmd(); });
    $("#cmdScrim").addEventListener("click", e=>{ if(e.target===$("#cmdScrim")) closeCmd(); });
    // modal
    $("#modalCancel").addEventListener("click", closeModal);
    $("#modalConfirm").addEventListener("click", ()=>{ const cb=modalOnConfirm; closeModal(); if(cb) cb(); });
    $("#modalScrim").addEventListener("click", e=>{ if(e.target===$("#modalScrim")) closeModal(); });

    // global
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    document.addEventListener("click", onDocClick);
    addEventListener("resize", onResize);

    // skeleton
    const sk = $("#skeleton");
    if(reduceMotion){ sk.classList.add("hide"); setTimeout(()=>sk.remove(), 50); }
    else { setTimeout(()=>{ sk.classList.add("hide"); setTimeout(()=>sk.remove(), 400); }, 500); }
  }

  function markAllRead(){
    state.events.forEach(e=>e.read=true);
    store.set(LS.events, state.events);
    renderNotifications(); renderEvents();
    toast("success","Notifications","All notifications marked as read.");
  }

  // guard against double init
  if(!window.__nebulaInit){ window.__nebulaInit = true; init(); }
})();
</script>
